svg.title: Issue 10 Page 22 Panel 4 — ISSUE CLOSER — Machen's full study, the city beyond, the mythologies grow
svg.desc: Wide James Machen's academic study in full — cork pinboard with growing web of blue and red pins, newspaper clippings, handwritten notes, hand-drawn map. Desk holds books, papers, ink, notecard with handwritten text partially visible. Machen stands before pinboard, arms crossed, thinking — lean man scholar's jacket, early thirties, intensity of someone who has found a pattern. Through window behind: Victorian city at night — gaslight halos, fog, chimney smoke, telegraph wires dark against sky. Somewhere too small to see, five tiny lights persist in a wall gap — implied, not visible. Warm amber desk lamp inside, cool gaslight and moonlight through window. The folklorist, the city, the stories becoming real. The beginning of a mythology.

g.text: Notes on Contemporary Folk Belief in the Metropolitan District
"The demons are real. The fairies are real. And now
someone is writing it all down."
